description: Hand-maintained catalog entries, changed only through a reviewed pull request. An entry here replaces the automatic entry with the same id (use it when a vendor blocks the CI fetcher or an adapter is wrong). Set checked_at to the time you confirmed the version on the vendor page; CI flags entries older than 60 days. List ids in allow_downgrade to accept a lower version than the published catalog has (for example after a vendor pulled a release).
